mapper.sql: activity_id, club_id, title, description, location, time, quota, need_audit, status, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT a.activity_id, a.title, a.description, a.location, a.time, a.status, c.name AS clubName, cc.name AS categoryName FROM activity a LEFT JOIN club c ON a.club_id = c.club_id LEFT JOIN club_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.category_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND c.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY a.time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (club_id, title, description, location, time, start_time, end_time, quota, need_audit, status, created_at) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{time}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{quota}, #{needAudit}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity WHERE club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY time DESC
